text: {"lessons":["I should not let gains or losses versus my average cost dictate whether I sell; I need to act on the stock’s prospects and my plan.","Rapidly adding to or trimming positions can increase risk without demonstrating an edge, so I should size holdings deliberately and stay diversified.","A small gain in my account does not show that I beat the market; I should compare long-run results with a suitable benchmark before judging my strategy."]}
